The Consultant

A Legacy of Excellence

With a career dedicated to organizational development, Tushar Dodia has established himself as a leading voice in India's financial and educational sectors. His approach is uniquely defined by a synthesis of modern strategic management and the timeless wisdom of ancient Indian philosophy. By drawing upon the narratives of the Ramayana and Mahabharata, he provides leaders with a framework for resilience, ethical decision-making, and institutional transformation that resonates across generations.
